item.title: Zeus
item.description: Zeus is a magnificent dog who needs an experienced owner. He’s very loyal and protective, making him an excellent guard dog for the right family.

item.title: Duke
item.description: Duke is a well-trained and well-behaved dog who loves to be around people. He’s great with children and other pets, making him an ideal family dog.

item.title: Rex
item.description: Rex is a powerful and protective dog who needs an experienced owner. With proper training and leadership, he will be a loyal and devoted companion.
